0022600224.text: The Utah Jazz host the Orlando Magic in Utah's 12th game of the season, with the Jazz at 1-10 (1-5 at home) on a nine-game losing streak, 15th in the West and 7 games back in the Northwest, while Orlando arrives at 3-7 (0-4 at home, 3-3 on the road) after a win and sits 11th in the East. Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic are out for Utah, and Keyonte George and Lauri Markkanen are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda and Paolo Banchero, with Tristan da Silva day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Utah lost both 2025-26 meetings, most recently 120-117 in Orlando on February 7, 2026.
